bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are allowed after search; opaque bags receive additional inspection.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The NC Music Factory lot across Hamilton Street past AvidXchange may charge an event-dependent rate; reserved VIP parking is adjacent to the deck and sold separately.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Rideshare drop-off and pickup are at the curb directly in front of the Fillmore box office.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The club sells food, alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks; valid photo ID is needed to buy alcohol.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is on the first deck level and outside the deck, first come first served with a placard; request other arrangements through the accessibility guide.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Concerts have no re-entry policy; an outdoor smoking patio connected to the venue is available near the restrooms.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call pickup requires photo ID matching the name on the guest list. The show-day box office opens about two hours before doors.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors generally open one hour before showtime. Mobile tickets are scanned at entry; pre-show patio guests enter before Fast Lane and general admission at the door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
